context.summary: Grounding, escalate/resume, supervision, the dictionary emitter and a bounded spine are all merged and green (41 tests, 0 warnings). But the fan-out that built them bypassed Made Well: every implementer wrote its own tests, which is the one wall this project holds sacred.
context.openThread: d001 — independent verification of the five merged packages. Their tests were written by the agents that wrote the code, so the suite currently proves self-consistency, not correctness. Nothing new gets built until that wall is restored.
